notes.classifier: Classification uses PLS-DA as the downstream model and inside VIP, SR, GA, and the length-validated selectors; CARS and BOSS build spectralselector.PLSDA internally.
notes.fermentation_test: Excluded because spectra and HPLC reference rows are time-aligned, not one-to-one supervised samples.
notes.selector_repeats: Only random_subset, CARS, BOSS, and genetic are repeated over selector seeds; deterministic methods are fitted once per fold.
